turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello, how are things going?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good, good. Thanks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to read more, but I'm always on the go.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Audiobooks might help, or an e-reader that fits in your pocket.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm, both sound good.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Which fits your day better, listening on the bus and at the gym, or reading in short quiet moments?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on a minute, I want to ask Sam something first. Don't jump in until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam, did you see the forecast for tomorrow?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, thunderstorms after three.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh. Do you still want to do the hike?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: We could start really early and be down by noon.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How early is really early?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Like leave the house at six.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine, but you're making the coffee.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is your brother back from university yet?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Next Friday, he says.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm here again, let's continue.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Still choosing between audiobooks and an e-reader?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Audiobooks. I'm driving like two hours a day.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect, that's a lot of books a year. Check if your library lends audiobooks for free.
